resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO or GPAW)

access.notes: Alternative: GPAW (https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/gpaw/). Any plane-wave DFT code capable of pseudopotential-based geometry relaxation may be used.

resources.notes: The agent chooses one open-source plane-wave DFT implementation for the calculations.

resources.name: Rh pseudopotential (ultra-soft or PAW) from SSSP precision library or equivalent

access.notes: SSSP precision v1.3 or newer provides well-tested, efficient pseudopotentials for Rh. An equivalent public pseudopotential library is acceptable.

resources.notes: The agent must select a pseudopotential that describes fcc Rh accurately and verify convergence.
